backfillRows.why: AoN feat-3619 prints "If you have Viking Weapon Familiarity or Viking Weapon Specialist, add the bastard sword and rapier to the list of weapons in those feats." critSpecSources (src/rules/derive.ts) reads each owned record's OWN crit-spec block and has no cross-record extension route, so the extension is carried on the extending record and gated by critSpecRequiresFeat (new this batch).

AoN feat-3619 names exactly these two weapons; both ids exist in public/core.json items. The two viking feats' own lists (battle-axe/hatchet/longsword/shortsword and the six-weapon familiarity list) are untouched — this ADDS, it does not replace.

AoN feat-3619's clause is conditional on owning one of the two feats it extends. BOTH are listed where WG gates on viking-weapon-specialist alone, because AoN feat-6437 (the remastered Viking Weapon Familiarity) itself prints "At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect" — adding a weapon to ITS list adds it to a crit-spec list too. WG's Viking Weapon Familiarity row encodes no WEAPON_CRITICAL_SPECIALIZATIONS at all, i.e. WG encodes less than print rather than contradicting it.

findings.note: Three rows on ONE record but three DIFFERENT top-level fields, so no merge is required. The reader (critSpecRequiresFeat on DefenseGrants + the gate in critSpecSources) shipped in this batch; without the gate these rows would hand a vindicator with neither viking feat a crit-spec grant print does not give them.

value.note: when you use Sudden Charge to Strike a target in shallow water, the target is off-guard against your Strike.

backfillRows.why: AoN feat-3619 prints "When you use Sudden Charge to Strike a target in shallow water, the target is off-guard against your Strike, as you use the water kicked up by your passage to camouflage your angle of attack." viking-vindicator grants Sudden Charge through featFeatGrants.ts:632, which copies the base feat's own text, so the granted entry printed nothing about shallow water. recordMarks is the live DATA route into recordMarkersFor (src/rules/explain.ts:711); FeatsTab.tsx:99 renders 'feature' marks on the granted feat's entry, and the mark is gated on owning viking-vindicator so an ordinary fighter's Sudden Charge is untouched.

findings.note: Reach, not a hidden mechanic — core-descriptions.json already carries the clause on the vindicator's own description. The gap is that the entry the player actually uses (Sudden Charge) carried no sign of it.

backfillRows.why: AoN feat-4099 prints "Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and number of spell slots you gain from gelid shard archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest gelid shard spell slots." The record carried only actionCost, so a gelid shard gained none of them. 'first-frost' is the gelid shard dedicationId (src/rules/casterArchetypes.ts:282), so archetypeEntryIds() yields 'first-frost-casting' and the live reader at build.ts:7061 widens the archetype pool. Identical shape to the shipped occult/divine/primal/patrons/mysterious-breadth rows.

findings.note: Data-only: the reader for this exact shape already exists and is exercised by the new test. The repertoire half of the printed sentence needs no separate field — a spontaneous archetype's repertoire is sliced from `slots`, so widening the slots widens both.

backfillRows.why: AoN feat-6230 prints "…number of spell slots you gain from SORCERER ARCHETYPE FEATS by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest sorcerer spell slots." The shipped row carried {perRank:1,exceptHighest:2} with no entryId, so slotEntryFor (build.ts:6846) resolved it to the character's FIRST spontaneous/prepared CLASS entry — a wizard dipping sorcerer took the slots on their wizard pool and a fighter got none at all, since the archetype entry is not pushed until build.ts:7129 and the archetype widener at 7061 skips any bonus without an entryId in archetypeEntryIds(arch). 'sorcerer-dedication' is the key in CASTER_ARCHETYPES (casterArchetypes.ts:191).

findings.note: SUPERSEDES the existing scripts/data/effect-backfill.json row {category:'feats',id:'bloodline-breadth',field:'spellSlotBonus',value:{perRank:1,exceptHighest:2}} — the superseded value is carried whole and only entryId is added. arcane-breadth carries the same entry-less shape and is the data-rows family's finding, not this one.

backfillRows.why: AoN equipment-3058 prints "The force grants you a +1 item bonus to AC and saving throws, and a maximum Dexterity modifier of +5 as armor." Only the half that PAYS the wearer was modelled: the bands are itemType 'equipment', so there is no armour block to hold the cap and a Dex +6 wearer added the full +6. Reader added this batch (ItemPassiveEffects.dexCap + passiveItemDexCap folded into deriveAc's dexCap as the lowest cap in play).

findings.note: SUPERSEDES the existing effect-backfill.json row {category:'items',id:'bands-of-force',field:'passiveEffects',value:{ac:1,saves:1}} — passiveEffects is ONE field, so the whole value is re-emitted with dexCap added. WG models no cap either, so this is print over both sides.
